articles.title: Chicago White Sox end the regular season with a win and head to Houston for the playoffs
articles.description: The Chicago White Sox closed out the regular season with a 4-2 win against the Colorado Rockies. Up next, the playoffs.

articles.title: Photos: Chicago White Sox 4, Colorado Rockies 2
articles.description: Photos from the Chicago White Sox’s 4-2 win over the Colorado Rockies at Rate Field on Sunday, Sept. 27, 2026.

articles.title: Chicago White Sox settle for AL's No. 6 playoff seed after loss
articles.description: The Chicago White Sox’s pursuit of the AL Central title ended Saturday with a 9-6 loss. The Sox are the No. 6 seed and will play at the West winner in a best-of-three wild-card series.

articles.title: How the Chicago White Sox defied history with turnaround
articles.description: The Chicago White Sox have come a long way in two years — going from a record 121 losses in 2024 to qualifying for the playoffs in 2026. Tracing some steps that led to the turnaround.

articles.title: Is the Chicago White Sox’s postseason chance a miracle? No comment, says Pope Leo.
articles.description: When asked by a reporter Friday if he had any influence over Chicago White Sox’s postseason advancement, Pope Leo wouldn’t say.

articles.title: Chicago White Sox complete rare turnaround from 100-loss team to playoff team: ‘It’s been an amazing ride’
articles.description: The Chicago White Sox clinched a playoff berth Thursday with a win against the Kansas City Royals, returning to the postseason for the first time since 2021.

articles.title: Column: After all the highs and lows, the Chicago White Sox have a clear path to the postseason
articles.description: The Chicago White Sox have a favorable schedule in the final week of their bid for a postseason spot. Here’s what needs to happen.

articles.title: ‘Incredible opportunity’: Chicago White Sox manager Will Venable on the season’s final stretch
articles.description: As they compete for a playoff spot, manager Will Venable recently discussed the “special” quality of the 2026 Chicago White Sox.

articles.title: Chicago White Sox hit 4 home runs to beat Kansas City Royals
articles.description: The Chicago White Sox hit four home runs and Chase Meidroth drove in five runs, as the Sox remained one game behind the division-leading Cleveland Guardians.
